feeds.title: Outdoor Photographer Blog
feeds.description: The Outdoor Photography blog has the latest photography news, gear, tips and technology, and features guest posts from pro photographers.

feeds.title: Andy Mumford Photography Blog
feeds.description: Andy Mumford is a Lisbon based professional landscape and travel photographer. He focuses on traveling, shooting landscapes and teaching photography through workshops and writing. Also you will find photography equipment reviews.

feeds.title: Michael Frye Photography Blog
feeds.description: Michael Frye is a professional photographer specializing in landscapes and nature, and the author and/or principal photographer of five books. Here's what you'll get when you subscribe to his blog - Landscape photography tips, Video tutorials, Popular photo critique series, Yosemite photo updates.

feeds.title: Owen Tomkins Photography Blog
feeds.description: I'm a landscape photographer from Yorkshire. I have spent a large part of the last 12 years exploring mountainous areas of Europe and further afield and the opportunities they provide. Photography has enabled me to document some of these adventures and I hope the images on this site convey just some of the sense of awe that I find in wild places.

feeds.title: Nickscape Blog
feeds.description: Peak District based Photographer capturing the beauty of the British Landscape and providing commercial editing and e-commerce services.

feeds.title: Capture Landscapes
feeds.description: Capture Landscapes is a provider of Landscape Photography Tutorials & Resources. Regardless of your ambitions and skill level, Capture Landscapes has what you need to improve your photography.

feeds.title: Nicolas Wauters Photography Blog
feeds.description: Focuses on traveling around the country, shooting Japanese landscapes and cityscapes. Nicolas Wauters is a Tokyo based landscape and urbanscapes photographer, specializing in Japanese landscapes, urbanscapes, and cityscapes.

feeds.title: National Parks at Night Blog
feeds.description: America's National Parks are breathtaking in the daytime, but at night they take on an otherworldly beauty. We hand-craft night photography workshops that provide world-class education from five diverse, experienced and enthusiastic instructors. The result is a rich experience full of adventure where you get individual attention and awe-inspiring images of natural nocturnal splendor.

feeds.title: On Landscape
feeds.description: On Landscape is a bi-weekly magazine dedicated to landscape photography from romantic to contemporary. We're all community and we'll feature photographs by all of our readers. There is great photography being created everywhere and we want to be one of the best curated galleries to find new talent.

feeds.title: Bruce Percy Blog
feeds.description: Bruce Percy is a landscape and travel photographer based in Scotland. Follow his blog for photographic stories from around the world.

feeds.title: Pete & Vicki Dobre Blog
feeds.description: Pete Dobré is a Freelance Photographer who blazes the trail for 6 months each year, capturing awe-inspiring images. Pete's work expresses his creative flair, emotions and love for the naturalscapes of Australia. Follow his blog for beautiful Australian and International Landscape Photographs by one of Australia's Leading Landscape Photographers.

feeds.title: Michael Breitung Photography Blog
feeds.description: Michael Breitung is a freelance landscape photographer from Germany and he lives near Nürnberg in the northern part of Bavaria. He started with photography in 2008. Blog posts contain articles about Landscape Photography and digital post processing and also tutorials by him.

feeds.title: Jennifer Carr Photography Blog
feeds.description: Photography blog sharing stories of places, pictures and techniques. Useful tips and tutorials for landscape, nature, and other genre photographers.

feeds.title: David Gibbeson Photography Blog
feeds.description: David Gibbeson is an outdoor, travel and landscape photographer based in Devon. He enjoys taking photos of the landscapes and coastline of the South West of England and beyond.

feeds.title: Andrew Barnes Photography Blog
feeds.description: Australian Landscape Photography Welcome to our site where you can enjoy beautiful images and buy Australian landscape photography. Andrew Barnes is an Australian landscape photographer based in Berowra, just north of Sydney, in New South Wales.

feeds.title: Peter McCabe Blog
feeds.description: Hi! My name is Peter McCabe. I am an Irish landscape photographer who for over 20 years has spent many a day, getting off the beaten track, exploring lesser worn paths to photograph the dramatic and subtle beauty of the Irish Landscape. My goal is to take you into the heart of the beautiful Irish landscape, enhance your photographic skills, and capture images that enhance your portfolio.

feeds.title: Outdoor Photographer
feeds.description: Outdoor Photographer is the ultimate guide to nature, wildlife, travel and adventure sports photography, featuring the work of renown photographers.

feeds.title: Matt Payne Landscape Photography Blog
feeds.description: The Matt Payne Photography Blog is a fine art nature and landscape photography blog that features articles, tutorials, gear reviews, trip reports, and podcast show notes.

feeds.title: Charlotte Gibb
feeds.description: Intimate Landscape Photography. Photographer Charlotte Gibb shares tips, tricks, travel and nature landscapes of Northern California.

feeds.title: The Landscape Photo Guy Blog
feeds.description: The Landscape Photo Guy is a photography blog by Belgian photographer Guy Lambrechts, focusing on landscape, nature, and architecture photography. It offers practical tips, creative techniques, and artistic insights to help photographers capture compelling images. Guy shares personal experiences and lessons from his travels, inspiring both beginners and enthusiasts to improve their skills and see the beauty in everyday scenes.

feeds.title: DELPHICAPHOTO Blog
feeds.description: Delphicaphoto is a fine art landscape and mountain photography site run by Ylenia Cantello. Through its blog, it offers reflective essays, tips, and insights on photography, nature, silence, and ethical environmental practices. It also hosts photographic treks as immersive experiences that blend creativity, wellness, and connection with nature.

feeds.title: Kai Hornung Photography Blog
feeds.description: Discover inspiring articles by award-winning German landscape photographer Kai Hornung. Dive into creative insights, behind-the-scenes stories, and practical tips for photographers who want to grow and stay inspired.

feeds.title: Chris Wright Photography Blog
feeds.description: Chris Wright's landscape photography blog highlights nature's moods through light, texture, and minimal compositions, encouraging reflection on quiet and atmospheric moments in the landscape.

feeds.title: Lightscapes Nature Photography Blog
feeds.description: Lightscapes Nature Photography Blog is a personal photography blog by Kerry Mark Leibowitz, a Midwest-based photographer who splits his time between Chicago and Indianapolis. The blog primarily focuses on landscape and nature photography, featuring detailed narratives and visual stories from various photo trips across the United States and beyond.

feeds.title: Gary Randall Blog
feeds.description: Gary Randall is a professional landscape photographer, writer, and photography guide based near Mount Hood, Oregon. For over 20 years, he has captured the beauty of the Pacific Northwest through vivid and emotionally rich images. His journey into photography began at the age of six with a Brownie Hawkeye camera. Later, while stationed on Midway Island with the U.S. Navy, his passion for wild places and visual storytelling truly took hold.

feeds.title: Luminous Landscape
feeds.description: The website has 5000 plus articles on just about any photo-related topic or camera you can think of. Luminous-Landscape has been providing original content, reviews, tutorials, and workshops for photo enthusiasts for over 16 years.

feeds.title: Outdoor Photography Magazine
feeds.description: Outdoor Photography is the leading magazine dedicated to landscape, wildlife, nature and adventure photography. Outdoor Photography is the UK's only magazine for photographers passionate about being out in wild places, seeing inspiring nature and having great adventures. And, of course, these activities also go hand in hand with an interest in conservation and the environment.

feeds.title: The Slanted Lens » Landscape Photography
feeds.description: The Slanted Lens' landscape photography section provides practical guidance, tutorials, and tips for photographers, focusing on improving skills, understanding gear, and capturing compelling outdoor and nature scenes.

feeds.title: Michael Russell Photography Photo Blog
feeds.description: Scenic Landscapes and nature photography by Canadian photographer Michael Russell featuring southwestern British Columbia and Washington State's Pacific Northwest.

feeds.title: luxBorealis Blog
feeds.description: Artist, author, and educator Terry McDonald approaches fine art photography as both art and craft, exploring a variety of visual styles to re-create 'the essence of place' and 'the art inherent in nature': dynamic, quintessential landscapes, engaging wildlife portraits, and intimate details of Earth's most awe-inspiring natural, historical, and cultural places.

feeds.title: Andrew Morse Blog
feeds.description: Andrew Morse is a Canadian landscape photographer based in Southern Ontario who explores remote and wild areas across Canada to capture dramatic and emotional landscapes. He offers fine art prints, publishes an annual calendar, and occasionally releases books. He also conducts limited photography education sessions and gives talks to photography clubs and groups.

feeds.title: Luke Tscharke Photography
feeds.description: Luke Tscharke is an Australian landscape photographer based in Hobart, Tasmania. With a background in biology and quality assurance, Luke transitioned from his corporate career to photography, motivated by his deep appreciation for nature and adventure. This change allowed him to combine his attention to detail with his passion for capturing natural landscapes.

feeds.title: Rach Stewart Photography Blog
feeds.description: Check out the latest blog posts from New Zealand landscape photographer Rach Stewart. A landscape, travel and adventure photographer eager to beautifully capture the natural world.

feeds.title: GITA Photos Blog
feeds.description: I am a Banff based Mountain Landscape Photographer. My home is Banff, gateway to the Canadian Rockies and Banff National Park.I shoot in the Canadian Rockies for most of my images. Banff National Park is home to some of the most stunning and breath taking landscapes and mountainscapes one can ever see.

feeds.title: Visual Wilderness Blog
feeds.description: Visual Wilderness is a community of dedicated photographers who are learning in a dynamic and exciting online environment. The blog provides photo tips, inspiration, real-life stories from some of the world's best landscape photographers.

feeds.title: Gary Holpin Blog
feeds.description: Discover the beauty of landscape photography with my blog. Explore stunning images, learn photography tips, and get inspired by the natural world. Follow my journey through the lens and enhance your photography skills.

feeds.title: Nature Photohgraphy Collective Blog
feeds.description: Tips and articles to help you develop your landscape photography skills from award-winning photographer Nic Stover.

feeds.title: Alex Burke Photography Blog
feeds.description: Hi! I'm Alex Burke. I venture deep into the wilderness so I can witness the most vibrant sunrises and sunsets from the best possible location. It is my goal to bring the entire experience of the journey and the majestic scenery to life in my photographs. Using a large-format film camera, I capture Colorado's magnificent beauty.

feeds.title: Loaded Landscapes Blog
feeds.description: Loaded Landscapes provides articles and resources focused on nature and landscape photography.

feeds.title: Land & Colors Blog
feeds.description: This website is mainly a landscape photography blog dedicated to capturing the beauty of the nature that surrounds us. It's administered and run by two landscape photographers - Otakar Hevler and Marek Potoma. Useful landscape photography tips, tutorials, technical information as well as darkroom processes.

feeds.title: Colby Brown Photography Blog
feeds.description: Colby is a photographer, photo educator and author based out of Eastern Pennsylvania. Specializing in landscape, travel and humanitarian photography, his body of work spans the four corners of the globe.

feeds.title: William Neill Blog
feeds.description: William Neill, a resident of the Yosemite National Park area since 1977, is a landscape photographer concerned with conveying the deep, spiritual beauty he sees and feels in Nature. In this blog you will find fine art and stock images of Landscape, and graphic patterns in Nature.

feeds.title: Exploring Exposure
feeds.description: David is a nomadic photographer traveling primarily the American West and sharing his love of photography with others along the way. Blog posts include camera gear reviews, tips, and tricks for landscape and night photography.

feeds.title: Daniel Wretham Photography Blog
feeds.description: Dorset based landscape photographer Daniel Wretham presents a collection of breathtaking images from all over the U.K. Get hints & tips to get your best landscape pictures.

feeds.title: Dzenis Photo Blog
feeds.description: Blog about general photography and landscape photography in Iceland.

feeds.title: Paul Zizka Photography Blog
feeds.description: Paul Zizka is an award-winning professional mountain adventure and landscape photographer based in Banff, Canada. Blog posts include landscape photography from Canada.

feeds.title: Everlook Photography
feeds.description: Everlook Photography is the combined photographic vision of husband and wife team, Dylan Toh and Marianne Lim. Their blog will be a combination of showcasing images and random musings about life and photography in general. Their writings will be purely their opinion only, based on their experiences.

feeds.title: Melvin Nicholson Photography Blog
feeds.description: Melvin Nicholson is a professional landscape photographer who specializes in UK and Iceland landscape workshops, personalized 1-2-1 tuition, print sales and camera club / private organizations talks and lectures.

feeds.title: James Grant Photography Blog
feeds.description: James Grant is a full-time professional landscape photographer mainly based in the Peak District but works UK wide.

feeds.title: Cornforth Images » Landscape
feeds.description: Jon is a full-time nature photographer. With over 16 years of traveling the world, Jon is known for shooting unique images in remote locations. Blog posts includes spectacular nature and wildlife photography prints, stock images for licensing, and photography tours by award winning photographer Jon Cornforth.

feeds.title: National Park Photography Expeditions Blog
feeds.description: National Park Photography Expeditions (NPPE) is the home of the Landscape Master Class where they explore inspirational locations and training designed to advance your visual skills and creative voice. Read the latest news on their blog where they explore topics on National Parks, and photography tips and tricks, product reviews, and more.

feeds.title: Christian Hoiberg Blog
feeds.description: I'm Christian Hoiberg, a Norwegian landscape photographer. Here you can read about my images, travels, equipment, and general thoughts about photography.

feeds.title: Andrew Thomas Photographer
feeds.description: Andrew Thomas is a landscape photographer based in Victoria, Australia.

feeds.title: Neil Mansfield » Landscape Photographs
feeds.description: Landscape Photography in the Brecon Beacons, Pembrokeshire, Snowdonia and all over the UK. On their Landscapes Uncovered Blog you find everything you need to know about landscape photography.

feeds.title: Skellig Photo Blog
feeds.description: Scenic Tours and Photography Tips by Michael Herrmann who is based in Ireland.

feeds.title: French Landscapes Blog
feeds.description: This blog is run by French photographer Patrick Morand. You will find here many images from France mostly from places between Corsica, Provence, and Jura department.

feeds.title: Jon Paul Blog
feeds.description: This is the Blog page of large format landscape photographer, Jon Paul. This is where you can see new images and read the stories behind Jon Paul's experiences in the field as he searches for and composes his amazing art with his large format film cameras. While based in South Lake Tahoe, California, Jon Paul will share stories of his photographic adventures near and far.

feeds.title: José Ramos Photography Blog
feeds.description: Landscape and Waterscape photography blog by José Ramos, from Portugal.

feeds.title: Anton Gorlin Blog
feeds.description: Beautiful pictures by Anton Gorlin. The portfolio includes ocean pictures, mountain and desert landscape and a hand-picked collection of meditation images.

feeds.title: James Bell Photography Blog

feeds.title: Paul Pichugin Landscape Photography Blog

feeds.title: Alex Wise Photography Blog

feeds.title: Adam Monk

feeds.title: Jack Lodge Blog

feeds.title: Nigel Waters Photography Blog

feeds.title: Moose Peterson Blog » Landscape Photography
